description: A logical knowledge base as a typed, event-sourced graph: declarations, statements, rules, constraints, queries, proofs, argumentation, processes, conflict policies, provenance records and interoperability mappings as primitives; every `Reference` field as a typed edge; the formula, term, type and concept languages as JSON validated by the vendored schema.
label: Logical Knowledge Base 1.0.0
name: logical-knowledge-base

primitive_types.description: The document header: schema and semantic-model versions, default semantics, logic profiles, canonical ordering and migration metadata. Exactly one per workbook; the fourteen collections are the other primitive types.
